name: SPOS Effects
description: Open-source library of 30 hand-crafted, pure-CSS effects with live demos and one-click copy. Zero JavaScript, zero dependencies. By SPOS Systems (صولة للأنظمة).

effects.name: Slide Fill
effects.description: A solid layer slides in from the left on hover while the label smoothly changes color, using a ::before pseudo-element and transform transitions.

effects.name: Neon Glow
effects.description: A cyberpunk-style neon button. Text-shadow and layered box-shadows bloom into a bright blue halo on hover.

effects.name: 3D Push
effects.description: A chunky retro arcade button with a hard shadow base. Pressing it (active state) sinks the button into its shadow for a physical 3D feel.

effects.name: Border Runner
effects.description: A comet of gradient light endlessly orbits the button border, built with a rotating conic-gradient pseudo-element clipped by overflow: hidden.

effects.name: Arrow Swap
effects.description: On hover the arrow icon slides out and a second one slides in from the right, while the button fills with color — a classic modern CTA micro-interaction.

effects.name: Ripple Press
effects.description: Material-style ripple that radiates from the center on every press, animated with the :active pseudo-class — no JavaScript required.

effects.name: Gradient Flow
effects.description: An animated multi-color gradient that flows endlessly through the letters, made with background-clip: text and a looping background-position animation.

effects.name: Typewriter
effects.description: Types and deletes text in a loop using the steps() timing function on the width property, complete with a blinking caret on the border-right.

effects.name: Highlight Sweep
effects.description: A highlighter marker sweeps across the text on hover by animating background-size from 0% to 100% — perfect for headings that reveal emphasis.

effects.name: Glitch
effects.description: Cyberpunk distortion: two colored copies of the text (via data-text attribute and pseudo-elements) jitter with randomized clip-path slices.

effects.name: Wave Letters
effects.description: Each letter rides a gentle wave with a staggered animation-delay, creating a rippling motion — no JavaScript, just per-letter spans.

effects.name: Dual Ring
effects.description: Two counter-rotating rings built with asymmetric border colors and opposite spin animations — a timeless spinner for any waiting state.

effects.name: Bouncing Dots
effects.description: Three playful dots bounce in sequence with staggered animation delays and a soft opacity breathing effect.

effects.name: Pulse Ring
effects.description: Radar-style expanding rings emitted from a solid core. Two pseudo-elements share one keyframe with a one-second offset for a continuous sonar pulse.

effects.name: Stripe Progress Bar
effects.description: An indeterminate progress bar: a striped block slides left-to-right with repeating-linear-gradient stripes scrolling inside it.

effects.name: Orbit
effects.description: A glowing moon circles a planet along a rotating dashed orbit — pure CSS astronomy using nested pseudo-elements.

effects.name: Hover Lift
effects.description: The card floats up with a soft blue glow on hover. A spring-like cubic-bezier easing makes the motion feel physical.

effects.name: 3D Flip
effects.description: A true 3D card flip on hover: preserve-3d keeps both faces in shared perspective while backface-visibility hides the far side.

effects.name: Spotlight
effects.description: Hovering reveals a radial spotlight that washes over the card. Tip: drive the position with a --fx-x/--fx-y custom property and two lines of JS to make it follow the cursor.

effects.name: Image Zoom Reveal
effects.description: A cover image (here a pure-CSS sunset gradient) zooms gently while a caption slides up with a gradient scrim — a classic media card pattern.

effects.name: Animated Gradient Border
effects.description: A rotating conic-gradient ring glows around the card forever. The ring is an oversized pseudo-element clipped by overflow: hidden.

effects.name: Shifting Gradient
effects.description: A deep blue gradient that slowly drifts across an oversized background — calm, ambient, and perfect for hero sections.

effects.name: Futuristic Grid
effects.description: A synthwave grid built from two repeating gradients, softly faded at the edges with a radial mask — instantly sets a tech mood.

effects.name: Drifting Dot Matrix
effects.description: A dot-pattern background that gently drifts forever. Made with a single radial-gradient tile and an animated background-position.

effects.name: Moving Diagonal Stripes
effects.description: Amber diagonal candy stripes that scroll seamlessly. The background-position period (67.88px) matches the 45deg stripe wavelength exactly.

effects.name: Aurora
effects.description: Two blurred orbs of light float and morph like the northern lights — layered pseudo-elements with filter: blur and slow transforms.

effects.name: Underline Grow
effects.description: Focus the field and a two-tone gradient underline grows outward from the center — powered by :focus-within and a transform-happy pseudo-element.

effects.name: Floating Label
effects.description: The label shrinks and floats to the top when the field is focused or filled. The trick: :not(:placeholder-shown) needs an empty placeholder to detect content.

effects.name: Glow Focus
effects.description: On focus the field lifts slightly and lights up with a layered amber glow — a friendly, tactile way to show where the user is typing.

effects.name: Expanding Search
effects.description: A circular icon that blooms into a full search field on focus. The wrapper animates its width while the magnifier glides to the right edge.
